comparison.objective: Choose and place the correctly sized blood-pressure cuff on a training arm; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Width-based selection and pose-controlled cuff placement; rigid cuff handling does not include keyed access, fine collar adjustment, or tightening.
comparison.success_condition: 8 cm cuff centered and oriented above elbow with no other cuff present; no indexed spec version beyond body rubric.
comparison.reason: Different selection and placement ability with unrelated completion criteria.
